versions.changelog:
- Initial release of caldav-calendar skill (v1.0.0).
- Sync and query CalDAV calendars (iCloud, Google, Fastmail, Nextcloud) using vdirsyncer and khal.
- Access 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS through the SkillBoss API.
- Requires a SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication.
